"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents stripped to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
EOF

"""Text truncation for previews."""


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters (including "..."), cutting at the last whole word that fits."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    avail = limit - 3
    # Look one character past the budget so a word ending exactly at `avail` is kept.
    candidate = text[: avail + 1]
    idx = max(candidate.rfind(" "), candidate.rfind("\t"), candidate.rfind("\n"))
    if idx <= 0:
        # No whole word fits in the budget.
        return "..."
    return candidate[:idx].rstrip() + "..."
EOF

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents stripped to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))

    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")

"""Text truncation for previews."""


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters (including "..."), cutting at the last whole word that fits."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    avail = limit - 3
    # Look one character past the budget so a word ending exactly at `avail` is kept.
    candidate = text[: avail + 1]
    idx = max(candidate.rfind(" "), candidate.rfind("\t"), candidate.rfind("\n"))
    if idx <= 0:
        # No whole word fits in the budget.
        return "..."
    return candidate[:idx].rstrip() + "..."
